docker.title: Docker backend
docker.description: Trusted Docker backend entry in ~/.captain.yaml under sandbox.backends.<name>. An image may instead come from the project's .container-sandbox.yaml. Host mounts and environment access are grants made by the machine owner.

image.description: Container image override. Required at execution when no project image is configured.

presets.description: Named dependency presets that grant host cache mounts and credential environment passthrough.

env.description: Environment variables expanded from the trusted machine environment and passed into Docker.

envPassthrough.description: Names of existing host environment variables to pass into the container.

volumes.description: Trusted host mounts as source:target[:ro]. Project configuration uses structured volume objects instead.

git-agent.title: Git Agent backend
git-agent.description: Trusted Git Agent backend entry in ~/.captain.yaml under sandbox.backends.<name>. Enrollment records are managed by captain sandbox git-agent add. This preview does not read credential files or contact agents.

relay.description: Mailbox relay behavior for dispatched tasks.

key.description: Path to the supervisor's dispatch SSH key. Defaults beside the Captain configuration.

mailboxRoot.description: Root served by the long-running mailbox endpoint.

waitTimeout.description: Positive Go duration for waiting for a terminal verdict, for example 1h or 30m. Runtime validation also rejects zero durations.

agents.description: Enrollment-managed endpoints and paths. Re-enroll an agent to update transport trust and credentials.

tokenPath.description: Path to the HTTPS dispatch token, never its contents.

caPath.description: Path to the trusted HTTPS certificate authority.
